{{Quote|Have you ever tasted my bantha cutlet with spicefruit reduction?|Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Bantha cutlet''' was a dish consisting of a thin slice of [[Bantha/Legends|Bantha]] meat. One variation was served with a [[spicefruit]] reduction. [[Wraith Squadron]] member [[Voort saBinring]] once boasted his bantha cutlet with spicefruit reduction.<ref name="MK" />
